patch.format: zero-context unified diff; apply with patch --batch to the fixed-SHA fresh copy

CPU_check.scope: compile actual candidate helper ASTs, preserving main workload AST except the actual available SHM boundary; real private writers/lease ownership, fake supervisor/idle snapshots, one isolated CPU rethrow child

changes: whole-run SHM safety boundary is the actual available filesystem bytes at run start; author/model bytes remain statistics, not quotas; no READY baseline reset
LEDGER.json reservation preserved; terminal goes to fresh LEDGER-TERMINAL.json
None counts or missing terminal stay unknown with a separate known subtotal
summary/monitor/final receipt errors cannot skip owner-token checked lease release
original error preserved; cleanup/logging errors become notes; final primary is rethrown for nonzero exit
execution_warning: Candidate keeps original HEAD/run paths for review. Apply to a COPY, then bind a fresh run/output identity and exact source before any authorized execution. Do not run the preserved r1 path.

replay_requirements.SEMLOOM_CODE_ROOT: path to the checked project code directory
replay_requirements.IMLANE_CONTROLLER_FIXTURE_DIR: private directory containing controller.original.py and patched controller.candidate.py

recovery: Use the original private controller matching the fixed SHA, apply controller_repair.patch to a fresh copy, and verify the candidate SHA. No full machine-bound controller or runtime paths are published.

resource_boundary.SHM: read actual /dev/shm f_bavail*f_frsize at run start; do not hardcode the observed snapshot
